title: Taiwan CDC signs a public health cooperation MOU with a New Southbound partner

zh-TW.reviewer: 國際合作組中文審核人

summary: Taiwan CDC signed a memorandum of understanding with a partner institution in Southeast Asia on tuberculosis and dengue control, laboratory training and information exchange.
bodyMarkdown:
Taiwan CDC signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) on public health cooperation with a partner institution in Southeast Asia under the New Southbound Policy.

The MOU covers tuberculosis and dengue control, laboratory training, migrant worker health and the timely exchange of information on cross-border events through IHR channels.

The cooperation will be reviewed each year, and its status is listed on the bilateral cooperation page.

This release is illustrative prototype content; the partner, date and scope are examples.

zh-TW.title: 疾管署與新南向夥伴簽署公共衛生合作備忘錄
zh-TW.summary: 疾管署與東南亞夥伴機構簽署合作備忘錄，合作結核病與登革熱防治、實驗室訓練及資訊交換。
zh-TW.bodyMarkdown:
疾管署依新南向政策，與東南亞夥伴機構簽署公共衛生合作備忘錄（MOU）。

合作範圍包括結核病與登革熱防治、實驗室訓練、移工健康，以及透過 IHR 管道即時交換跨境事件資訊。

合作每年度檢討，狀態列於雙邊合作頁。

本則為原型示意內容，夥伴、日期與範圍為示例。
